speaker: Holmes
dialogue_text: No, no, my good sir, There is a master hand here. It is no case of sawed-off shotguns and clumsy six-shooters. You can tell an old master by the sweep of his brush. I can tell a Moriarty when I see one. This crime is from London, not from America.

speaker: Unknown
dialogue_text: But for what motive?
source: Project Gutenberg #3289 - The Valley of Fear

speaker: Unknown
dialogue_text: Because it is done by a man who cannot afford to fail, one whose whole unique position depends upon the fact that all he does must succeed. A great brain and a huge organization have been turned to the extinction of one man. It is crushing the nut with the triphammer—an absurd extravagance of energy—but the nut is very effectually crushed all the same.
source: Project Gutenberg #3289 - The Valley of Fear

speaker: Unknown
dialogue_text: How came this man to have anything to do with it?
source: Project Gutenberg #3289 - The Valley of Fear

speaker: Unknown
dialogue_text: I can only say that the first word that ever came to us of the business was from one of his lieutenants. These Americans were well advised. Having an English job to do, they took into partnership, as any foreign criminal could do, this great consultant in crime. From that moment their man was doomed. At first he would content himself by using his machinery in order to find their victim. Then he would indicate how the matter might be treated. Finally, when he read in the reports of the failure of this agent, he would step in himself with a master touch. You heard me warn this man at Birlstone Manor House that the coming danger was greater than the past. Was I right?
source: Project Gutenberg #3289 - The Valley of Fear

speaker: Unknown
dialogue_text: Do not tell me that we have to sit down under this? Do you say that no one can ever get level with this king devil?
source: Project Gutenberg #3289 - The Valley of Fear

speaker: Holmes
dialogue_text: No, I don’t say that, I don’t say that he can’t be beat. But you must give me time—you must give me time!
